lines.en: I guess I’ll see if Ami has any plans today.
lines.zh: 我去看看 Ami 今天有没有安排吧。

lines.en: I woke up feeling a lot more exhausted than normal for some reason, so the idea of going anywhere right now sounds like nothing more than...unnecessary pain.
lines.zh: 不知为什么，今天醒来感觉比平时累得多，所以现在要出门什么的，听起来纯属……自讨苦吃。

lines.en: Combine that with the fact that all I'd be doing is searching for another cute girl to hang out with and there's really no reason for me to ever leave at all.
lines.zh: 再加上出门无非是再找个可爱女孩一起玩，那我压根就没有出门的理由。

lines.en: Everything I could ever want is right here at home.
lines.zh: 我想要的一切，家里都有。

lines.en: : Oh, Sensei! Good morning. I was just going to come wake you up and see if you wanted to go out.
lines.zh: : 哦，Sensei！早安。我正想去叫你起床，看看你想不想出门。

lines.en: God damn it.
lines.zh: 靠。

lines.en: : Nope. I'll just stay here and be miserable.
lines.zh: : 不去。我就烂在这儿。

lines.en: : You're not allowed to be miserable while I'm here. That's one of our house rules, remember?
lines.zh: : 我在的时候不许丧。这是家规之一，记得吗？

lines.en: : I remember no such thing. Where could you possibly want to go this early in the morning?
lines.zh: : 我可没这条记忆。一大早的，你还能想去哪？

lines.en: : Some new diner thingy just opened up the other day and I figured the two of us could go together since going to a diner by myself would make me look really lame.
lines.zh: : 前几天新开了家小餐馆，我想咱俩一起去——一个人去餐馆显得超逊的。

lines.en: : Are Ayane and Maya busy today or something?
lines.zh: : Ayane 和 Maya 今天是有事吗？

lines.en: : I don't think they're busy...but chances are that both of them are still sleeping.
lines.zh: : 应该不是忙……不过她们俩八成还在睡。

lines.en: : You...don't want to call them and find out?
lines.zh: : 你……不想打个电话问问吗？

lines.en: : Sensei...can you look down, please?
lines.zh: : Sensei……麻烦你往下看一眼好吗？

lines.en: : What? Why?
lines.zh: : 什么？为什么？

lines.en: : It's just that I've dropped so many hints about wanting to do this alone with you over the last two minutes that they are now making the house look messy.
lines.zh: : 因为过去两分钟里，我暗示「想跟你两个人去」的暗示堆得太多，已经把家里弄得乱糟糟了。

lines.en: : Don't drop hints. It's best to just speak your mind, Ami.
lines.zh: : 别暗示。有话直说最好，Ami。

lines.en: : I literally did that and you just said you'd stay here and be miserable!
lines.zh: : 我明明直说了，你却说你烂在这儿不走！

lines.en: : Prove that you love me and come have breakfast at the new diner with me or I will throw myself off a bridge and leave a note saying you made me do it!
lines.zh: : 证明你爱我，陪我去新餐馆吃早餐——不然我就从桥上跳下去，遗书就写是你逼我的！

lines.en: : It was nice knowing you, Ami.
lines.zh: : 认识你很高兴，Ami。

lines.en: : Sensei!
lines.zh: : Sensei！

lines.en: : I'm obviously kidding. I'll come. Just...give me a minute to get dressed since I was really planning on spending the whole morning here.
lines.zh: : 开玩笑的。我去就是了。只是……给我一分钟换衣服，我本来是打算整个上午都窝在家里的。

lines.en: : Really?! You'll go on a date with me?!
lines.zh: : 真的？！你要跟我约会？！

lines.en: : I'll come to the diner with you. I don't think I'm allowed to date my niece.
lines.zh: : 我是陪你去餐馆。跟自己侄女约会，应该是不被允许的。

lines.en: : Says who? There's no rule like that I've ever heard about before.
lines.zh: : 谁规定的？这种规矩我可从来没听说过。

lines.en: : Then you haven't been paying much attention to societal norms or values. This place isn't far, is it?
lines.zh: : 那你平时没怎么留意社会规范和价值观。那家店不远吧？

lines.en: : Not super far. Maybe like...a mile or two?
lines.zh: : 不算特别远。大概……一两英里？

lines.en: : You're really going to make me walk a whole mile as soon as I wake up?...
lines.zh: : 你真打算让我一睡醒就走上一整英里？……

lines.en: : You walk to other places all the time. What's the harm in walking somewhere with a cute relative at your side?
lines.zh: : 你平时不也到处走。身边带个可爱的亲戚走走路，能有什么坏处？

lines.en: : Besides, the two of us could use a little exercise, don't you think?
lines.zh: : 再说，咱俩都该运动运动了，你不觉得吗？

lines.en: : Unless there's some other sort of physical activity that the two of us could do together in the comfort and privacy of our own home.
lines.zh: : 除非有什么别的「体力活动」，能让咱们俩在自己家里舒舒服服、私私密密地一起做。

lines.en: : Isn't that being a little too suggestive this early in the morning?
lines.zh: : 一大早就说这么有暗示性的话，是不是有点过分？

lines.en: : I have no idea what you're talking about. I just want to spend some quality time with my uncle.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你在说什么。我只是想跟叔叔共度美好时光而已。

lines.en: : I am sure you do...
lines.zh: : 你肯定是的……

lines.en: I head back to the bedroom and change my clothes, wondering how serious Ami was about the whole physical activities thing and...whether or not I'd be serious about that as well.
lines.zh: 我回卧室换了衣服，心里琢磨着 Ami 那番「体力活动」到底几分认真，以及……我是否也会跟着认真起来。

lines.en: But seeing as I don't want to walk one or two miles with an erection pressing up against the inside of my jeans, I decide to abandon the thought and simply think of nothing instead.
lines.zh: 但考虑到我不想顶着牛仔裤里那根顶起的东西走一两英里，我决定掐灭这个念头，干脆什么都别想。

lines.en: After a decently long walk, we make our way into a relatively old-fashioned, American style diner.
lines.zh: 走了相当长一段路后，我们进了一家颇有年头的美式小餐馆。

lines.en: The air conditioner in here is turned on full-blast, making it an extremely welcome escape from the sweltering summer heat we were forced to battle on the way over.
lines.zh: 店里空调开到最大，一路顶着酷暑走来的我们，简直像逃进了避难所。

lines.en: For being what Ami claims is a new business, the diner is surprisingly empty.
lines.zh: 按 Ami 的说法这是家新店，店里却空得出奇。

lines.en: Only a few tables are occupied by customers while a single waitress makes her way around the room, checking on each and every table while Ami and I figure out what we want to eat.
lines.zh: 只有几桌坐了客人，一个女服务员在店里来回转，一桌一桌地问着——我和 Ami 正琢磨吃什么。

lines.en: : Sensei, do you know what you’re gonna get yet?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你想好点什么了吗？

lines.en: : I have no clue.
lines.zh: : 完全没头绪。

lines.en: : Do you want something sweet? Or do you want something savory? Because I heard online that the doughnuts here are crazy good.
lines.zh: : 你想吃甜的还是咸的？网上说这里的甜甜圈好吃到爆。

lines.en: : But also, you shouldn't get the doughnuts because that's what I'm getting.
lines.zh: : 但你也别点甜甜圈，因为那是我要吃的。

lines.en: : You know what? I'll just choose for you. Get something savory and we can share with each other if it really comes down to it.
lines.zh: : 这样吧，我替你选。你点咸的，真到万不得已，我们还能互相分着吃。

lines.en: : Well, that certainly makes things easier for me.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这倒是省事多了。

lines.en: : A little more freedom would be nice, though.
lines.zh: : 不过，再给我多一点自由就更好了。

lines.en: : You're free to do whatever you want! As long as what you want to do is love me.
lines.zh: : 你想干什么都自由！只要你干的事是爱我。

lines.en: : Kidding.
lines.zh: : 开玩笑的。

lines.en: : Maybe.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。

lines.en: I think my niece might be obsessed with me.
lines.zh: 我觉得我侄女可能对我有点执念过深。

lines.en: : Hello, humans! And welcome to food! My name is Kaori Kadowaki and I will now write down the objects you wish to consume on this rectangular book of slaughtered trees.
lines.zh: : 你们好，人类们！欢迎来到食物！我叫 Kadowaki Kaori，现在我将把你们想要吃掉的东西写在这本由惨遭屠宰的树木制成的长方形册子上。

lines.en: Isn't this the same girl that was working at the bistro where I met up with Sara and Haruka?
lines.zh: 这不是我跟 Sara、Haruka 见面那家小酒馆打工的同一个女孩吗？

lines.en: Isn't she a little young to be working multiple jobs?
lines.zh: 她打这么多份工，是不是有点太小了？

lines.en: : That's funny. I don't remember seeing anything online about this diner being themed.
lines.zh: : 有意思。我可不记得网上有说这家店是主题店。

lines.en: : Yes! Themed! The theme here is hunger! And the characters are you and the large, intimidating man with circles of glass in front of his vision balls.
lines.zh: : 没错！主题店！这里的主题是饥饿！角色就是你和那个高大的、吓人的、眼球前面架着两个玻璃圈的男人。

lines.en: : You...said your name was Kaori?
lines.zh: : 你……刚才说你叫 Kaori？

lines.en: : Yes! That is what I am called. But you may also address me as the Mistress of the Dark or the Queen of Spiders. All of these things are true! I think!
lines.zh: : 没错！那是我的称呼。不过你也可以叫我黑暗之主，或是蜘蛛女王。这些统统属实！大概！

lines.en: : Have you been inside of this building before?
lines.zh: : 你以前来过这家店吗？

lines.en: : Not yet. I've seen a lot of people talking about it online, though.
lines.zh: : 还没。不过我在网上看到很多人在讨论。

lines.en: : On which line?
lines.zh: : 在哪条线上？

lines.en: : The...The Internet?
lines.zh: : 网……网上？

lines.en: : Did you also bring a net? Or did your girlfriend just require moral support for all of the flavors she is going to catch?
lines.zh: : 那你带网来了吗？还是说你的女朋友捕捉各色猎物时，只需要你在旁边精神支持？

lines.en: : G-G-G-G-G-Girlfriend?! Is that who you think I am?! Does it really look that way?!
lines.zh: : 女、女、女、女、女朋友？！你就这么看待我的吗？！我们看起来真像那样？！

lines.en: : Was my assumption incorrect? I smelt a heavy dose of romantic pheromones shortly after the two of you entered the store.
lines.zh: : 是我判断错了吗？你们两位进店后不久，我就闻到了浓烈的恋爱信息素。

lines.en: : Pheromones?!
lines.zh: : 信息素？！

lines.en: : So strong that they are almost pulsating! I can feel them surrounding my body and squeezing me the way I long to squeeze small dogs.
lines.zh: : 浓到几乎在搏动！我能感觉到它们裹住我的身体、用力挤压我——就像我平时很想挤压小狗那样。

lines.en: : Treat her well or face the consequences.
lines.zh: : 好好待她，不然后果自负。

lines.en: : What would you like to eat, small girl?
lines.zh: : 你想吃什么，小姑娘？

lines.en: : I am serious. Protect this tiny human.
lines.zh: : 我是认真的。保护好这个小小的人类。

lines.en: Am I wrong for feeling mildly intimidated right now?
lines.zh: 我现在感到轻微的被威慑，是我错了吗？

lines.en: : What is your name and how many muffins have you eaten in your life?
lines.zh: : 你叫什么名字，你这辈子吃过几个玛芬？

lines.en: : Please also inform me on the object on our menu that you most want to put inside of your mouth.
lines.zh: : 还请一并告知，我们的菜单上你最想把什么东西放进嘴里。

lines.en: : Well, umm...
lines.zh: : 那个，呃……

lines.en: : My name is Ami...
lines.zh: : 我叫 Ami……

lines.en: : An adorable name for an adorable girl. Tell me what your desired food is called, Ami.
lines.zh: : 可爱的女孩配可爱的名字。告诉我你想吃的食物叫什么，Ami。

lines.en: : Uhh...there's a...doughnut platter thingy, right?
lines.zh: : 那个……有一个……甜甜圈拼盘什么的，对吧？

lines.en: : That is a thing that exists. Yes.
lines.zh: : 那个东西存在。是的。

lines.en: : And for you, mystery man? Please list the objects you are most interested in at this very moment.
lines.zh: : 那么你呢，神秘男？请列出你此刻最感兴趣的东西。

lines.en: I'm beginning to think that Ami is right in assuming that this is some sort of themed diner, but...I can't really tell what the theme is by the way the waitress is speaking.
lines.zh: 我开始觉得 Ami 猜对了，这确实是某种主题餐馆，但是……光听这服务员的说话方式，我实在判断不出主题是什么。

lines.en: : I’ll just have a burger. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 我就要个汉堡。谢谢。

lines.en: : I understand. One order of fried zeros and a hot meat sandwich coming right up for the cute Ami and her human boyfriend.
lines.zh: : 收到。一份炸零圈和一个热肉三明治，马上为可爱的 Ami 和她的人类男友呈上。

lines.en: : Please remain at this specific rectangle and I will return right away.
lines.zh: : 请留在这一特定长方形区域内，我马上回来。

lines.en: Kaori or...the mistress of whatever disappears from the table, prompting Ami and I to awkwardly resume where we left off moments ago.
lines.zh: Kaori，或者……随便什么的主人，从桌边消失了，留下我和 Ami 尴尬地捡起几分钟前的话题。

lines.en: : She’s...umm...
lines.zh: : 她那个……呃……

lines.en: : A little-
lines.zh: : 有点——

lines.en: : I have returned with the things you wanted!
lines.zh: : 我带着你们想要的东西回来了！

lines.en: : How the hell did you do that so quickly?
lines.zh: : 你怎么可能这么快？

lines.en: : Do not ask questions that you are not yet prepared to hear the answers to!
lines.zh: : 不要问你还承受不起答案的问题！

lines.en: : For there is one nickname I did not mention when I first introduced myself...
lines.zh: : 因为初次见面时，我还有一个称号没有报上……

lines.en: : You see before you, Kaori...the Goddess of Gluttony...the world’s greatest waitress...
lines.zh: : 在你眼前的，是 Kaori……暴食女神……世界最强的女服务员……

lines.en: : How...what?...
lines.zh: : 怎么……什么？……

lines.en: : If anything, I’m more impressed with the cooks. All you really did was carry everything over.
lines.zh: : 真要说，我更佩服的是厨师。你做的事不过就是把东西端过来而已。

lines.en: : And we didn’t even order the coffee you gave to Ami.
lines.zh: : 而且你端给 Ami 的咖啡，我们根本没点。

lines.en: : The Ami needs the hot bean water to grow strong and develop larger bones!
lines.zh: : Ami 需要热豆子水才能变强壮、长出更大的骨头！

lines.en: : I think there might be some misunderstanding on your end about the nutritional value of coffee.
lines.zh: : 我想你对咖啡的营养价值可能存在一些误解。

lines.en: : Do not tempt me to return your meat to the cooking zone! I will do it!
lines.zh: : 不要逼我把你的肉退还给烹饪区！我真的做得出来！

lines.en: Kaori quickly snatches back the burger she had placed in front of me before I’m even able to take a bite.
lines.zh: Kaori 飞快夺走了刚摆在我面前的汉堡，快到我一口都没咬上。

lines.en: : I am so confused.
lines.zh: : 我好混乱。

lines.en: : You will eat when I deem you worthy.
lines.zh: : 待我认定你配得上时，你才能吃。

lines.en: : Umm...Miss Kaori?
lines.zh: : 那个……Kaori 小姐？

lines.en: : What is wrong? Will your tiny body reject the strength of the hot bean water?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？你那小小的身体是承受不住热豆子水的力量吗？

lines.en: : No, I just...was wondering if that spider on your chest was a real tattoo or not?
lines.zh: : 不，我只是……好奇你胸口那只蜘蛛是真纹身吗？

lines.en: : It is. Would you like to touch it?
lines.zh: : 是真的。要摸摸看吗？

lines.en: : I...don't know if I should with where it's located.
lines.zh: : 我……看它长在的位置，不知道该不该摸。

lines.en: : I understand. Human customs say that a spider on one's body must not be touched until the seventh date.
lines.zh: : 我明白。人类的习俗说，身上的蜘蛛要到第七次约会才能碰。

lines.en: : I didn’t realize there was a custom for something that specific.
lines.zh: : 我不知道还有这么具体的习俗。

lines.en: : May I ask you a question now, Ami?
lines.zh: : 那么现在我也能问你一个问题吗，Ami？

lines.en: : Of course. What do you want to know?
lines.zh: : 当然。你想知道什么？

lines.en: : What is your favorite animal?
lines.zh: : 你最喜欢的动物是什么？

lines.en: : Is that...really what you want to ask?
lines.zh: : 这……真的是你想问的？

lines.en: : Do you not have one?
lines.zh: : 难道你没有吗？

lines.en: : Um...I guess...I think cats are really cute?
lines.zh: : 那个……我想……我觉得猫特别可爱？

lines.en: : I see, I see.
lines.zh: : 原来如此，原来如此。

lines.en: : I will remember this.
lines.zh: : 我会记住的。

lines.en: : Okay...umm...
: Thank you?
lines.zh: : 谢谢？

lines.en: : You are very welcome.
lines.zh: : 不用客气。

lines.en: : As for you...
lines.zh: : 至于你……

lines.en: : What did I do?
lines.zh: : 我干什么了？

lines.en: : I will allow you to eat this hot meat sandwich under one condition.
lines.zh: : 我允许你吃这个热肉三明治，但有一个条件。

lines.en: : And what condition would that be?
lines.zh: : 什么条件？

lines.en: : You must say one nice thing about me.
lines.zh: : 你必须夸我一句好话。

lines.en: : What? Why?
lines.zh: : 什么？为什么？

lines.en: : Because you have jammed an invisible knife into my feelings and they are now deflating.
lines.zh: : 因为你把一把看不见的刀捅进了我的感情，它们正在漏气。

lines.en: : Please patch me up immediately.
lines.zh: : 请立刻替我补好。

lines.en: : Uhh...
: You're...really attractive?
lines.zh: : 你……真的很有魅力？

lines.en: : GUH!
lines.zh: : 咕啊！

lines.en: : That...That is not the type of nice thing I thought you would say, boyfriend-man!
lines.zh: : 这……这不是我以为你会说的那种好话，男友男！

lines.en: : Yeah...me neither.
lines.zh: : 是啊……我也没想到。

lines.en: : And I'm extra annoyed because I actually agree.
lines.zh: : 而且我格外恼火，因为我自己居然同意。

lines.en: : You look kinda like a...rock idol or something. And you're super cool and now I'm jealous.
lines.zh: : 你长得有点像……摇滚偶像之类的。而且你超酷，现在我好嫉妒。

lines.en: : The Ami thinks that too?! Is this what they call a gangbang?!
lines.zh: : Ami 也这么想？！这就是他们说的多人运动吗？！

lines.en: : Uhh...no. No it's not.
lines.zh: : 呃……不。不是的。

lines.en: : All I wanted was my role as the greatest waitress in the world to be validated by a large man and his miniature girlfriend!
lines.zh: : 我只是想让我「世界最强女服务员」的身份，得到一个大块头男人和他的迷你女友的认可而已！

lines.en: : Now, I must deal with the extra blood in my face! And all because of you two!
lines.zh: : 现在，我必须处理我脸上多出来的血！而这一切都是拜你们俩所赐！

lines.en: : We...weren't trying to offend you, Miss Kaori. We just-
lines.zh: : 我们……不是想冒犯你的，Kaori 小姐。我们只是——

lines.en: : I will now depart! The weight of these comments has become too much for me to bear!
lines.zh: : 我现在就告辞！这些话语的重量已经超出我的承受范围！

lines.en: : Please remember to like, comment, and subscribe!
lines.zh: : 请记得点赞、评论、加关注！

lines.en: Kaori vanishes into the kitchen, leaving both Ami and me in a state of mild shock.
lines.zh: Kaori 消失进厨房，留下轻度震惊的我和 Ami。

lines.en: But, on the bright side, the room quickly grows much quieter.
lines.zh: 不过往好处想，店里很快安静了许多。

lines.en: : So, uhh...I guess we just...eat breakfast now?
lines.zh: : 那个……我看我们是不是就……现在吃早餐？

lines.en: : What just happened?
lines.zh: : 刚才发生了什么？

lines.en: : I’m not really sure...
lines.zh: : 我也不太确定……

lines.en: : I kind of like her, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我有点喜欢她。

lines.en: : What? Why?
lines.zh: : 什么？为什么？

lines.en: : I...don't really know.
lines.zh: : 我……也说不上来。

lines.en: : I just kind of...do.
lines.zh: : 就是……有点喜欢。

lines.en: Ami and I finish up our meals without any further interruption from the diner staff...
lines.zh: 我和 Ami 吃完了这顿饭，餐馆员工没有再来打扰……

lines.en: Something tells me this isn’t the last we’ve seen of Kaori, though...
lines.zh: 不过，有种直觉告诉我，这不会是我们最后一次见到 Kaori……
